program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "itail": (2.0e-6, 1.0e-6, 4.0e-6),
    "gmidp": (12.0, 6.0, 16.0),      # PMOS mirror + M7 (same density -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmidn": (12.0, 6.0, 16.0),      # NMOS ref/tail/M8 mirror family
    "Ln":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "i2":    (5.0e-6, 2.0e-6, 8.0e-6),
    "cc":    (2.2e-12, 0.8e-12, 4.0e-12),
    "kz":    (1.8, 0.5, 4.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
    "gmidc": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # tail cascode gm/Id
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.3, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it, i2, cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["cc"]

    # PMOS mirror (diode) and M7 at identical current density
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], it / 2, vds=0.8)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.8)

    # diff pair: iterate tail node voltage including body effect
    vt = 0.3
    for _ in range(5):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=max(0.3, vdd - m3.vgs - vt), vsb=vt)
        vt = max(0.15, vcm - m1.vgs)

    # NMOS mirror family from ibias (same vds -> proportional W)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], it, vds=0.6)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], i2, vds=0.6)

    # tail cascode; split the tail headroom between the two devices
    vdsb = max(0.08, 0.45 * vt)
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], it, vds=max(0.08, vt - vdsb), vsb=vdsb)
    # resistor-based cascode bias: vcasc = vgs_r + Iref*R = vdsb + vgs_c
    R = max(100.0, (vdsb + mc.vgs - mr.vgs) / iref)
    rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias -> R -> diode Mr
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "nb", R)
    n.dev("MR", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mr)
    # tail: bottom source + cascode (gate at ibias node)
    n.dev("MT", "nt", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MC", "tail", "ibias", "nt", "vss", mc)
    # DP: M1 (diode side) = vinn, M2 (output side) = vinp
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    wp2 = m7.gm * cc / (C1 * cc + C2 * cc + C1 * C2)
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * max(1e-3, rz - 1.0 / m7.gm))   # LHP if rz > 1/gm7
    wp3 = 1.0 / (rz * C1)
    wu = 2 * PI * ugbw
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wp2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wp3)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wz))
    rtail = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs + mc.gds) / (mc.gds * mt.gds)
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm * rtail)
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    nth = math.sqrt(2 * (8 * kT / 3) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = 3.0 * nth                         # rough flicker allowance
    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cl + cc))
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2)
    psrr_db = db(A1 * A2) - 20
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "slew": slew, "swing": swing, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller OTA with Rz nulling and a cascoded NMOS tail
